missionPremise: OPS-21 A-124/P-147: S1 (P-132, write side) and S4 (P-135, verdict side) independently derived one number -- 3,376 parcels x 5 counties (44/26/1014/1021/1271), summing exactly -- as the zoningDistrict residual gating eight of nine written rails. The dispatch frames this as (up to) four populations, only one of which (bucket 4, genuinely stampable) this lane may apply, and requires characterisation before any apply.

step1_characterisation_STOP_AND_REPORT.instruction: Dispatch: STEP 1 IS CHARACTERISATION, NOT A RUN. Report before you apply anything.
step1_characterisation_STOP_AND_REPORT.headlineFinding: Bucket 4 is EMPTY. The entire 3,376-parcel residual is bucket 3 (already not-applicable), and every single one of the 3,376 is verified LEGITIMATE -- not a defect, not a drift, not this job's to fix. There is nothing for this lane to apply.

masterFact_globalCheck.executedLive: 2026-09-11, FACTORY host ep-round-base-au0jofwp/neondb, read-only, both primary and replica, identical results.
masterFact_globalCheck.conclusion: Zero unaccounted zoningDistrict cells exist ANYWHERE in the store -- not just within the 3,376-parcel subset S1/S4 named, but across all six counties and every city, in-scope or not. Buckets 1 (undeclared-city polygon miss, which stays unaccounted by construction) and 4 (genuinely stampable, which by definition requires kind='unaccounted') are therefore structurally empty right now, full stop, independent of which specific population is examined. Bucket 2 (STAMP_GAP_EXCLUDED_CITY_KEYS) is separately moot: that constant is `Object.freeze([])` in current code (PARCEL-R5B-STAMPGAP, authorized 2026-09-02) -- no city is excluded by it today; the five formerly-excluded cities are handled live via DECLARED_LAYER_GAP (Elgin only) / buildStampSourcedCells, neither of which contributes to this residual (see below).

theRealFinding_outOfThisLanesScope.statement: The eight downstream rails are not blocked on zoningDistrict RESOLVING (it already has, correctly, for all 3,376 parcels). They are blocked on S1's (parcel-setback-cells.mjs) and by the same class S2's (parcel-envelope-cells.mjs) writers having no branch for a not-applicable zoningDistrict: both writers' documented gate is 'has the zoningDistrict cell reached value or refused' (S1's own close: 'not yet value or refused'). A legitimately not-applicable zoningDistrict (unzoned land in a declared-complete city) will NEVER become value or refused -- there is no zoning district to look up on land the city itself never zoned, and parcel-r5-zoning's UPDATE is gated to `cell_state->>'kind' = 'unaccounted'` (STANDING FACTS), so it will never revisit an already-not-applicable cell either. These 3,376 parcels' setback/envelope cells are therefore PERMANENTLY unaccounted under the current S1/S2 logic, with zero path to resolution short of teaching those writers to recognize a not-applicable zoningDistrict and propagate not-applicable onto their own rails (unzoned land arguably has no setback or building-envelope requirement to measure either).
theRealFinding_outOfThisLanesScope.isThisLanesToFix: NO -- dispatch explicitly: 'Fixing S1's deferral rule' is out of scope, and 'do not fix S1's writer from here.' This finding is reported, not actioned.
theRealFinding_outOfThisLanesScope.correctionToDispatchPremise: The dispatch's 'What done looks like' section states that after this lane applies bucket 4, re-running the setback/envelope writers 'continues closing the eight rails automatically... no code changes in either.' Given bucket 4 = 0, re-running those writers now will move ZERO additional cells -- nothing about their inputs has changed or will change from this lane's work. Per DEV_PROCESS 3.2 ('the brief's numbers are the planner's, and the planner is often wrong; say so'), this is flagged as a correction, sourced to the live counts above, not asserted from a prior close.
